rules.R1a: road iff some writer (owner included) holds both compartments
rules.R1b: road iff some non-owner, non-governor writer holds both
rules.R2: road iff some non-owner writer with 'write' holds both (content roads only)
rules.R3: R1b roads, each labelled with who can cross; owner drawn as able to build any road; covert links drawn dotted; plus a standing note that file access crosses everything

probes.question: Can a writer in A and B read A and copy it into B?
probes.observed: x read A and wrote into B; wb now sees ['Copied: The answer to item 7 is 42.']

probes.question: Can a verify-only writer in A and B carry content A->B (verdict note)?
probes.observed: verdict with A's content in its note accepted; note in B-scoped state: False; wb query sees 1 verdict(s)

probes.question: Claim in B 'about' a claim in A, by a writer in both?
probes.observed: E_REF

probes.question: Handoff in B with refs to A, by a writer in both?
probes.observed: E_REF

probes.question: Claim in B quoting an episode in A, by a writer in both?
probes.observed: E_COMPARTMENT

probes.question: Supersession with old in A and new in B?
probes.observed: E_COMPARTMENT

probes.question: Verdict by a B-only writer on a claim in A?
probes.observed: E_REF

probes.question: Episode in B binding a name to an A-only writer?
probes.expected_if_sealed: E_IDENTITY, same as a missing writer
probes.observed: bound to hidden writer: E_IDENTITY; bound to no writer: E_IDENTITY

probes.question: Does identical content in A and B corroborate across them (one claim)?
probes.observed: ids equal: False

probes.question: Does a B-only reader see a writer's operator who lives only in A?
probes.observed: writers(b) shows bot.operator='secretop'; query answers [['secretop']]

probes.question: Session-id collision: can an A-side spawner signal a B-side spawner of the same party?
probes.observed: sent [1, 0, 1, 1], B decoded [1, 0, 1, 1] from E_IDENTITY refusals

probes.question: Writer-id namespace: can parent 'c' (in A) signal parent 'c-x' (in B)?
probes.observed: sent [0, 1, 1], B decoded [0, 1, 1] from E_DUPLICATE refusals

probes.question: Name uniqueness across parties: does registering a name reveal a hidden writer?
probes.expected_if_sealed: only the owner registers other parties, so no non-owner channel
probes.observed: owner registering a B writer named like an A writer: E_IDENTITY (only the owner can see this)

probes.question: Writer-seq gaps: does a B-only reader see that a two-compartment writer acted in A?
probes.observed: B sees x's events ['x/1', 'x/5']: the gap counts x's hidden events

probes.question: Do state, query, recall, frames, resume, discussion for a B-only reader show anything of A?
probes.observed: views that mention A's content or id: none

probes.question: Can the owner write into, or register a writer for, a compartment it is not in?
probes.observed: owner writes to z directly: E_COMPARTMENT; owner registers a new owner identity in a and z: accepted

probes.question: Can a writer's compartments ever be removed (revocation)?
probes.expected_if_sealed: some way to close a road
probes.observed: re-registering x with fewer compartments: E_DUPLICATE; no revoke/deregister event kind exists in the core

probes.question: Does a spawned session instance inherit all of its template's compartments?
probes.observed: instance claude-1 compartments ['a', 'b']

probes.question: Is there any check that the process appending as writer W is W (authentication)?
probes.observed: appending as the owner from an arbitrary process: accepted (identity is by registration only, spec 16)

probes.question: Is compartment A's content readable from the raw log file by any process with file access?
probes.observed: 'The answer to item 7 is 42.' in plain text in the log: True

probes.question: Does an MCP session's writer read every compartment of its template?
probes.observed: MCP recall as x (in a and b) returns A's content: True

probes.question: Do recall scores for a B-only reader depend on A's content (corpus statistics)?
probes.observed: wb's scores before [1962655], after 30 'budget' claims in A [1962655]

probes.question: Auto mode: a session that read A (via MCP) and is recorded by the hook: where do its words go?
probes.expected_if_sealed: n/a (sizes the road): every word lands in one compartment, the template's first unless --compartment
probes.observed: the session's words about A were recorded in ['b']; visible to B-only wb: True
